title: ChroniUXMag: A Persona-Driven Framework for Inclusive mHealth Requirements Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2511.18634v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Context: Mobile health (mHealth) applications for chronic disease management present challenges in accessibility, inclusivity, usability, and sustained engagement. Clinical context, caregiver involvement, trust, and long-term use create domain-specific requirements engineering (RE) challenges.   Objective: This study introduces ChroniUXMag, a framework for eliciting and analysing inclusivity requirements in mHealth design, building on InclusiveMag and GenderMag.   Method: ChroniUXMag was developed using the Scope and Derive stages of InclusiveMag. Evidence came from a systematic literature review, focus groups, interviews, and an online survey. Candidate inclusivity facets were identified from literature and empirical data, organised into personas representing diverse health situations, attitudes, and digital practices, and integrated into an adapted cognitive walkthrough form. translated_title: ChroniUXMag：一个以用户画像驱动的包容性移动健康需求工程框架
translated_abstract: 背景：用于慢性病管理的移动健康应用在可访问性、包容性、可用性和持续用户参与方面存在挑战。临床情境、照护者参与、信任和长期使用带来了特定领域的需求工程（RE）挑战。目标：本研究提出ChroniUXMag，这是一个用于在移动健康设计中引出和分析包容性需求的框架，它建立在InclusiveMag和GenderMag的基础之上。方法：ChroniUXMag采用InclusiveMag的范围界定和推导两个阶段开发。证据来源于系统性文献综述、焦点小组、访谈和在线调查。研究从文献和实证数据中识别出候选的包容性维度，将其组织成代表不同健康状况、态度和数字实践的用户画像，并整合到改编后的认知走查表单中。结果：十三个定性类别被整合提炼……
tldr: ChroniUXMag是一个建立在InclusiveMag和GenderMag基础之上、以用户画像驱动的框架，通过文献综述、焦点小组、访谈和调查识别包容性需求维度，并将其整合到认知走查中，用于改进慢性病管理移动健康应用的包容性需求工程。
en_tdlr: ChroniUXMag is a persona-driven framework built on InclusiveMag and GenderMag that elicits inclusivity requirements for mHealth apps through literature review, focus groups, interviews, and surveys, and integrates them into an adapted cognitive walkthrough for chronic disease management design.
